reviews.author: Pooja R.
reviews.text: Beautiful park with plenty of activities for all ages! There’s a nice playground for kids and a swimming area with options to rent kayaks and jet skis. Campsites are well-maintained, and the bathrooms (with showers) were clean. While most sites don’t offer much privacy, the lake views and stunning sunsets more than make up for it. We even caught fireworks from the lake — such a fun bonus! We stayed at campsite 85 and really enjoyed our time here.

reviews.author: J B.
reviews.text: Chelan State Park is beautiful. You've got a great camping area, solid bathrooms with showers, a generous playground and the beachfront at the base of the stairwell. Designated swimming is blocked off to keep watersports from crossing over into swimmers. Lovely park and would recommend it to anyone looking for some light, family camping.

reviews.author: Julie W.
reviews.text: Lovely campground! Beautiful Lake! Rented a boat in town and had a few lovely days with the family. Has a swimming area, playground for kids. Only thing I wish it had more of is beach area. A wonderful place to go!

reviews.author: K M.
reviews.text: Such a beautiful, clean lake.  The bathroom near our campsite had 4 individual showers and clean bathrooms.  Beautiful view of the lake.  Be prepared fir lots of boating noise in the summer, and I mean a lot!  Campsite had great view of the water and the sunrise.

reviews.author: Shannon K.
reviews.text: Beautiful place to go. Mountain view lodge is amazing place to stay with your family including your 4 legged friend. If going for fishing, I suggest a boat before June when the lake is full after June there will be better bank fishing

reviews.author: Wildcraft Rose
reviews.text: End of July it's hot weather. Take a cool clear water swim in the lake, paddleboard, jetski, go boating. Get bags of ice or maybe a 2 scoop ice cream cone at the concession/store there. You can camp almost right on the water, near a big grass field, under a shade tree - and there is also group camping. Free showers and bathrooms are cleaned daily. Kids playground, volleyball, and a hiking trail. I saw deer roam the campground while I watched the beautiful sunrise. This is an excellent place to go camping.
reviews.ratingNote: explicit 5/5 shown on Wanderlog page for the same review (listed as 'Wildcraft R')

reviews.author: Cyndi Markle
reviews.text: This is a nice park with camping and day use areas. There is a grass and tree covered area with picnic tables. At the lake's edge, there are grass or sand areas to set up your spot. They have an enclosed swimming area. There is a small store to make food and sundry products purchases. The bathroom has showers and are very clean.

reviews.author: Ivy
reviews.text: Beautiful! I wanted to think it was overrated but I see why people would drive 3 hours to this lake as opposed to other nearby ones. It's large! Plenty of space for everyone, whether on the water or around the lake, so you can enjoy the serene landscape without having to hear other people's conversations and music. Plenty of parking too. There is a sandy beach but you could also walk to the quieter sides where there are spots under the trees for foldable chairs and canopies. You may have to pay at the booth coming in: $10 for day use or $30 for annual pass (Discover Pass). There is a teeny gift section in the booth, some magnets, thermal flasks, and t-shirts.

reviews.title: best place on earth!
reviews.author: froglag
reviews.text: I love lake Chelan it's like my second home. I go here every summer with family and friends the lake may be cold but you will get used to it! good to boat and fish and the best part is the milkshakes they have at the shop definitely recommend! if you have kids they will love the park, it has nets to play volley ball and a open space to play soccer! definitely come here! it's worth the 3 hour drive from Seattle!

reviews.title: Our Happy place
reviews.author: froglag
reviews.text: This campground is beautiful. Great views of the lake. If you have kids they have a great playground with lots of grass to play volleyball, baseball, or other recreational activities. We were campground hosts for the month of May and we never tired of the Ranger and staff and of course the beautiful park itself. We definitely will be back. Added plus of having great fishing as well.

reviews.title: Good one night stay to be able to catch early boat up lake in early am.
reviews.author: Jill D
reviews.text: This campground has great access to the water of Lake Chelan, for boaters and swimmers alike. The sites were clean and kept up, the bathrooms modern and regularly cleaned. The campground is too open and populated for a long stay for me, but was a perfect overnight to catch the boat up lake the next day.
reviews.ratingNote: sentiment-mapped: positive with minor caveat (too open/populated for a long stay)

reviews.title: Wonderful campground- cougar sighting on hiking trail
reviews.author: Greg K
reviews.text: This is a wonderful campsite. Hikers beware: the Little Bear Trail right near the campground has cougar sightings. We were on the hike 6/25/22 and encountered a Large Cougar on the trail. The trail is closed down, but please keep small children and pets safe in the campground.
reviews.ratingNote: sentiment-mapped (page shows no per-review bubbles); calls it 'a wonderful campsite'

reviews.title: Functional RV Campground, But Tight
reviews.author: kayteeYVR
reviews.text: Lake Chelan is a jewel. At a depth of 1486 ft is the 3rd deepest lake in the U.S. and 50.5 miles long, nestled between the arid mountains of eastern Washington. Mile upon mile of rugged natural beauty. The RV area of the campground sites, however are tightly packed. If neighbors are not courteous their loud conversation is annoying. The outer side of the RV park has plenty of shade. The inner side is much less shady. Not a problem in the spring/fall, but could be really sun baked in the summer. The restrooms were clean and we'll supplied. You must pay for tokens to use the shower...1 token = 3 mins. Tokens purchased via a dispenser at the ranger station. Passing vehicles on the nearby road are easily heard. The camp sites are very close to the lake, but not actually on the lake/beach. If the RV sites were better situated and with more space I would have given a 5-star.
reviews.ratingNote: reviewer explicitly withheld 5 stars due to tight RV sites ('would have given a 5-star') -> 4

reviews.title: Camping trip
reviews.author: maria k
reviews.text: This park is wonderful. It is a ways down from town so nestled in the mountains makes for a nice outdoors experience. Great beach area with loading docks for boats and other water crafts. They have paddle board and kayak rentals available. Need to reserve in advance if you want to camp here.

reviews.title: Better for tent camping than RV's
reviews.author: UnrepentantFoodie
reviews.text: This is an old campground. The main camping area is hilly, rustic and uneven so only suitable for tents and small truck campers. Anything that requires levelling will be mostly relegated to a newer more manufactured area off to one side with no lake views. Not a problem for many, but to us with a small 22 ft Sprinter it was disappointing. We didn't need hookups but we did need level ground and our choices seemed meager. We didn't stay more than one night. For those with fewer limitations, the park offers lake access, grassy areas for games, and public restrooms with good showers. And I must throw in kudos for park staff--we had 'issues' making the reservation once we arrived (the online reservation system is live and instantantaneous, so people arriving without reservations have to buy the spot immediately upon selection lest someone booking from afar and not arriving until later that day book it out from under you). We botched our first attempt, and several employees went out of their way to help us.
reviews.ratingNote: sentiment-mapped: mixed (disappointing for their rig, kudos for staff)

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL PARK BY WATER
reviews.author: stacy b
reviews.text: Lots of Duck and Geese when we were there. Pretty park with shade trees. Great for walking dog. A nice place for a break from driving.
reviews.ratingNote: explicit 5 shown in TripAdvisor snippet ('5 Reviewed 3 July 2019')

reviews.title: Beautiful camping with great docks and day use area
reviews.author: froglag
reviews.text: This is our 5th yearly stay at this park and love it every time we stay. This year we camped over free discovery pass day and it was a bit more crowded. We did find it to be very quiet in the morning and in the evening hours which made sleeping very comfortable. They are working on the park and making improvements to keep it to be the popular place it is.
